transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thank you. Well, to be honest, I'm here because something scared me recently. I've started having these thoughts... just catching myself thinking things like, 'It would be simpler if I just didn't wake up tomorrow.' 

I want to be clear that I don't have any sort of plan to harm myself, or anything like that. But just having those thoughts at all... it scared me enough to realize I needed to come in and talk to someone.
I'm glad you reached out for help. Aside from those thoughts, how has your mood been feeling overall lately?

Well, overall, it's just been... very low. Most days, I feel as if a gray film has settled over everything. It's a bit hard to describe, but even when I’m just doing my normal routines—like making a cup of tea, or looking out at my garden—there’s this quiet heaviness in me. I try to tell myself I have no reason to feel this way, but I just can’t quite reason my way out of it.
About how long have you been feeling this heaviness and low mood?

I'd say it's been going on for about eight months now. It started right around the time... well, since my brother's health and behavior changed so suddenly. That's really when I first noticed this feeling setting in.
Before this began eight months ago, had you ever experienced a period in your life where you felt this low or depressed?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've had sad days, of course, like anyone else. But nothing like this... this constant heaviness. Before eight months ago, I never felt anything quite like this.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yes, I have. I used to love painting... watercolors. I still set my things out sometimes, thinking I'll paint. But I just sit there staring at the blank paper, and then I end up putting it all away. The pleasure I used to get from working with the colors and the light... it just isn't there anymore.
How have your energy levels been lately?

My energy? It's... well, I think it's been okay. I haven't really noticed a big change there. I mean, I'm not doing as much as I used to, but that's more about just not wanting to do things, rather than feeling physically exhausted. So, my energy itself seems fine.
How has your sleep been over these past few months?

It hasn't been very good. I have a hard time at night... I fall asleep pretty unevenly. And then I almost always wake up around three or four in the morning. Once I'm awake, my mind just starts going—I lie there thinking about phone calls I need to make, or forms I have to deal with, and worrying about whether I handled things correctly. By the time morning actually comes, I feel as if I've hardly rested at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite recently?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My appetite has been... pretty much the same as always. I still eat my regular meals, so I don't think there's been any difference.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating on things, or having trouble making decisions?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I can still sit and read a book or follow along with a conversation just fine. And as for making decisions... no, that hasn't been a problem either. I think my mind is still working the way it usually does for those sorts of things.
Have you been troubled by strong feelings of guilt, or feeling like you are worthless or letting people down?

Yes, I have been dealing with a lot of guilt. I just keep going back over my brother’s decline, and... I keep telling myself that if I had been a better sister, or just more attentive, I would have noticed what was happening sooner. I really feel like I could have prevented some of this if I had just paid more attention.
Have you ever experienced a time when you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, elated, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

No, I haven't ever experienced anything like that. I've always been someone who needs a regular night's rest, and... well, I can't think of a time I felt unusually energetic or elated. My energy levels have always just been pretty normal, I'd say.
